title: Apple proposes to take a 15% cut of purchases made outside the App Store | TechCrunch
summary: Under the proposed structure, small business developers would pay a 5% commission on payments, while those in the Video Partner Program, News Partner Program, and Mini Apps Partner Program would pay 10%.
